target.statement: Accuracy of OURS on Zh⇒En NIST05 test set (average across four translation context types) is 65.61.

compute.basis: Training requires 8 V100 GPUs for 50k steps on 1.25M sentence pairs; on a CPU-only laptop this is infeasible, and even with a GPU it would take days.

blockers: Requires LDC corpus (LDC2002E18, LDC2003E07, LDC2003E14, LDC2004T07-08, LDC2005T06) which is not freely available.
Training uses 8 NVIDIA V100 GPUs, far beyond a normal laptop.
Code repository may not include preprocessed data or exact configurations.
title: An Energy-based Model for Word-level AutoCompletion in Computer-aided Translation
